assignments.name: Assign_Owner_To_Queue
assignments.label: Assign Owner to Investor Onboarding Queue

Flow.description: Before-save flow (Create only) that assigns ownership of newly created Investor Onboarding Leads (RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Investor_Onboarding') to the Investor Onboarding Queue. The queue is resolved by Group.DeveloperName ('Investor_Onboarding_Queue') AND Group.Type ('Queue') -- both filters are required, because Group.DeveloperName is unique per Type rather than globally, so filtering on the name alone can match a public group of the same name. Never a hardcoded Id. Fails closed: if no matching queue is found, $Record.OwnerId is left untouched rather than written null. Before-save is deliberate -- the assignment happens in memory during the user's own save, so it costs no extra DML and no second trigger pass. SCOPE -- Lead_Intake_Stamp is the only other before-save flow on Lead. It is scoped to the Acquisition_Broker record type and this flow to Investor_Onboarding, so the two match disjoint populations and cannot race; no triggerOrder is needed on either while that split holds. If either flow's entry criteria is ever widened so both can match one record, revisit this: Lead_Intake_Stamp stamps DPEG_First__c only when the owner is a User (LEFT(CASESAFEID(OwnerId), 3) = "005"), so an owner reassignment to a queue running first would silently suppress that stamp. REPLACES the deactivated DPEG Lead Assignment Rule, and note the behaviour is wider: an assignment rule was opt-in and fired only when a caller requested it (e.g. the layout checkbox), whereas this flow fires on every qualifying Create -- including API, Apex and data-load paths -- with no per-record opt-out.
Flow.label: IR Lead Assignment Flow
